topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: I never thought I'd see it there, in that small, dimly lit case among other forgotten treasures. The ring, with its simple yet elegant band and the diamond that once sparkled under the sun, seemed so out of place. It was the one she always spoke of with such fondness, how Grandfather had saved for months to buy it, how it was a symbol of their unbreakable bond. Holding it now, the cold metal feels heavier than I remember. I wonder how it ended up here, if anyone else has tried it on, if they knew whose hands it adorned for so long.
